title: Toll Holdings Limited - completed acquisition of SkyNet Worldwide Express

timeline.event: Toll Holdings Limited acquired SkyNet Worldwide Express.
ACCC commenced review under the Mergers Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: In December 2007, Toll Holdings acquired SkyNet Worldwide Express, which was a Sydney based provider of international and domestic express freight services.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purposes of assessing this acquisition, the ACCC considered the following markets: the national market for the supply of express freight services (Australian express freight market); and  the market for the supply of express freight services to and from Australia (international express freight market).
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. The ACCC considered that Toll will continue to face competitive constraints from a number of strong competitors which exist in both the Australian and international express freight markets and the threat of new entry or expansion.
